items.title: How fast does the combinatorial gap actually grow?
items.description: Reproduces the exact formula verified in L3: composition costs moveStyles + attackStyles components, while modeling every combination as its own subclass costs moveStyles × attackStyles. Defaults (3, 3) reproduce the unit's exact 6-vs-9 reading. Drag either slider up to see how quickly the multiplicative cost pulls away from the additive one.
items.compute: return { composition: params.moveStyles + params.attackStyles, inheritance: params.moveStyles * params.attackStyles };
